member.name: M:GalaxyCoreLib.GalaxyApi.ClearSessionState
member.summary:
Removes state that belongs to one transport session.
A disconnected client must not keep network entities or instance members alive: those objects describe the server session which has just ended and cannot be reused safely after reconnecting. Keeping cleanup here also gives real and virtual transports exactly the same lifecycle semantics.
